title: Tiger cub
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>

  </defs>
  <!-- glow background -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='42' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='24' ry='18' fill='#ff9933'/>
